answer: Escrow payment until the work is graded, then tax any attestation that came from one subnet. Two edge cases matter: an identity may not audit its own recruit, or a referral tree grades itself, and escrow releases on a grader signature, never on a timer. A farm registering 1,000 accounts from one address space pays the subnet tax on every panel it stuffs. The float sits in a vault, not on the operator's jetty, and no lagoon of idle accounts hides it.
